guidance: Fresh Ironclad A0 run at 68/80 HP with Impervious and Molten Fist after one hallway win. Only legal next map node is Monster. Preserve HP across early rooms: remove attacking enemies or use currently effective block; do not end a turn with a basic Defend still playable when it reduces incoming damage. The controller now enforces that narrow E015 condition, but all other choices remain yours. Bash gives Vulnerable for follow-up attacks; Molten Fist is 10 damage, doubles Vulnerable and exhausts, so use it when damage or existing Vulnerable matters. Impervious is a large one-turn block, not a reason to ignore future damage. Burning Blood heals 6 after a win. At the reward, prefer reliable frontloaded damage, block, draw or energy over a speculative archetype; skip weak cards. Use a potion proactively if it prevents meaningful loss or secures a kill. Re-read every fresh hand and target before acting; stop at next MAP.
